scope: Twenty paired research-intent probes for the NPS Pacific project grouping and existing associated places. These are cohort-focused diagnostics, not a blind benchmark, a complete inventory, relevance judgments or lifecycle assertions. Source State and ISO country-or-area labels do not infer historical sovereignty; restricted location records need no point to be discoverable.
